The wizard has lost the keys to his manor.
Lucky for you, in this manor, everything opens.
Every drawer, door and lid you're about to see was made with Aholo Lux3D, starting from a single sentence.
We describe a piece of furniture, and in about two minutes, Lux3D builds the 3D model.
Then Lux3D's articulation splits it into parts, and gives every drawer a real joint: which way it slides, and how far.
In the game, every one of those joints becomes a hiding spot.
Fifty-five pieces. A hundred and seven working joints. Ten levels, by day and by night.
Pick a room from the manor map, and start rummaging.
Some are padlocked, so find the little brass key first.
At night, the lights go out. Search by flashlight, and check the walls: keys hide behind paintings, and under floorboards.
Stuck? A hint gives you a clue, not an arrow. Ask again, and the hiding spot glows.
Feeling lucky? Bet your time on a coin flip.
find every key, and earn your stars.
Run out of time, and the manor shows you exactly what you missed.
Then hide a key yourself, and send the challenge to a friend.
Rummage runs in any browser, on desktop or on your phone.
